presidentSection.title: Message from the National President
presidentSection.subtitle: A lifelong struggle for the dignity, equality and empowerment of the underprivileged
presidentSection.bio: For over two decades, Shri Keshav Dev Maurya has spearheaded grassroots mobilization for the constitutional rights, social recognition and economic empowerment of backwards, Dalits, farmers and working-class families across the region. He believes genuine democracy requires equal access to governance and representative power for every section of society.

foundationSubtitle: Building an egalitarian, exploitation-free society rooted in equality, dignity and constitutional justice
foundationCards: Establishing a fair and casteless social order where every citizen enjoys equal opportunity and respect without prejudice.
Upholding the vision of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar to safeguard constitutional protections and rule of law for all.
Providing transparent and accessible public assistance so that development reaches the last person in society.
agendaSubtitle: Our core priorities for transparent governance, public welfare and social upliftment

agendaDetails.title: Quality Education & Free Competitive Coaching
agendaDetails.desc: Ensuring modern, high-standard schooling and free competitive coaching for children from economically disadvantaged, rural, and backward households.

agendaDetails.title: Dignified Employment & Skill Development
agendaDetails.desc: Timely recruitment in vacant public service positions, promoting local micro-industries, and offering zero-interest entrepreneurial seed loans for youth.

agendaDetails.title: Constitutional Social Justice & Caste Census
agendaDetails.desc: Guaranteeing equitable representation in governance, administration, and resource distribution proportional to population shares.

agendaDetails.title: Universal, Accessible & Free Healthcare
agendaDetails.desc: 24/7 fully-equipped primary healthcare centers at every block and village panchayat level with free medicines and emergency services.

agendaDetails.title: Women Security, Respect & Economic Empowerment
agendaDetails.desc: Financial backing for women-led self-help groups, robust safety frameworks in public spaces, and 50% representation in decision-making bodies.

agendaDetails.title: Farmers Welfare, Fair MSP & Worker Dignity
agendaDetails.desc: Legally binding Minimum Support Price (MSP) at 1.5x input cost, timely fertilizer supply, free irrigation electricity, and enhanced daily wage rates.

inspirationSubtitle: Honoring the legendary pioneers of social equality, knowledge, self-respect, and revolution

inspirationsList.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule
inspirationsList.title: Father of Social Revolution
inspirationsList.desc: Founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj, who pioneered universal education and equal human dignity for the downtrodden.

inspirationsList.name: Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule
inspirationsList.title: Pioneer of Women’s Education
inspirationsList.desc: India’s first female teacher and courageous reformer who broke deep-seated social taboos to educate girls.

inspirationsList.name: Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj
inspirationsList.title: Pioneer of Affirmative Action
inspirationsList.desc: Visionary king of Kolhapur who enacted 50% reservation and free universal schooling for backward communities in 1902.

inspirationsList.name: Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar
inspirationsList.title: Architect of the Constitution
inspirationsList.desc: Global champion of human rights and justice who enshrined liberty, equality, fraternity, and constitutional democracy.

inspirationsList.name: Emperor Ashoka the Great
inspirationsList.title: Universal Monarch & Patron of Dhamma
inspirationsList.desc: Exemplar of compassionate welfare governance and non-violence whose Lion Capital and Ashoka Chakra are India’s national emblems.

inspirationsList.name: Manyavar Kanshi Ram Ji
inspirationsList.title: Bahujan Social Revolutionary
inspirationsList.desc: Political strategist who infused political consciousness and power-sharing consciousness into marginalized masses.
